blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ска́зывать** — (antiquated, poetic) to utter, to narrate. Wiktionary: сказа́ть + -ывать.
**спра́шивать** — to ask (to ask a question of). Wiktionary: спроси́ть + -ивать.
**взгля́дывать** — to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance. Wiktionary: взглянуть + -ывать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to ask (to ask a question of)
to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ска́зывать — (antiquated, poetic) to utter, to narrate; спра́шивать — to ask (to ask a question of); взгля́дывать — to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance; расска́зывать — to tell.
**прика́зывать** — to order, to command, to give orders, to direct. Wiktionary: приказа́ть + -ывать.
**загова́ривать** — to begin to talk. Wiktionary: заговори́ть + -ивать.
**протя́гивать** — to stretch, to extend. Wiktionary: протянуть + -ивать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to order, to command, to give orders, to direct
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пока́зывать — to show; прика́зывать — to order, to command, to give orders, to direct; загова́ривать — to begin to talk; протя́гивать — to stretch, to extend.
**ука́зывать** — to show, to indicate. Wiktionary: указа́ть + -ывать.
**дока́зывать** — to prove, to demonstrate. Wiktionary: доказа́ть + -ывать.
